before.scope: Registered forest selected-LOD rest geometry. Leaf components link by bounding-box proximity, then leaf-surface samples test wood-triangle contacts. Alpha cutout is evaluated only in alpha mode (opaque-texel bounds); shader wind is not; candidates require visual review. Null sampled gap means no nearby triangle was found, not an exact distance.

scope: Actual production factory source pair on the same loaded GLB templates. Original numeric static attribute/index hashes must match every native registered oak LOD/part (excluding per-instance aDistanceCoverage). Candidate positions applied to every derived native colour/depth/shadow geometry; no card deletion or addition. Native raster restored before all recorded images. Controlled geometry adapter, not two-binary image comparison or hardware performance measurement.
